nodes.name: Schedule 12:00
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 12:00 (noon) in the workflow timezone. Set timezone in workflow settings (default Europe/Istanbul).

nodes.name: Schedule 18:00
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 18:00 (6 PM) in the workflow timezone.

nodes.name: Sync All Sheets to Redis
nodes.notes: Reads every office/month spreadsheet listed in your Bot Authority registry, stores Leads + FTD + Info Agents in Redis via POST /api/sources, and refreshes authorized users. No Google node is required in n8n when using Bot Authority.
